name: TEMP - AURON Reel Dry-Run (container+polling only, safe to delete)

nodes.name: Google Drive: Share Reel Video
nodes.notes: Instagram's reel-container step fetches the video itself from a URL, same as the image path -- AURON never uploads bytes. Note: Drive's uc?export=view link can serve an HTML can't-scan-for-viruses interstitial instead of raw bytes for very large files; not handled here.

nodes.name: IG: Create Reel Container
nodes.notes: media_type=REELS tells Instagram this container is a Reel, not a feed video. Reel processing takes materially longer than an image container, which is why this path polls status_code below instead of the fixed wait the single_image/carousel paths still use (not touched here).

nodes.name: Wait for Reel Processing
nodes.notes: Loop target: re-entered on every 'not finished yet' pass below until status_code is FINISHED or the hard cap of 20 attempts is hit.

nodes.name: Route: reel container finished?
nodes.notes: TRUE -> publish the reel. FALSE -> check whether the poll budget is exhausted before looping back.

nodes.name: Route: reel polling exhausted?
nodes.notes: $runIndex is THIS node's own execution count within the current run -- it increments every time the loop cycles back through 'Wait for Reel Processing' and reaches this node again. 0-indexed, so runIndex 19 is the 20th pass: 20 attempts x 5s wait = up to ~100s of polling before giving up with a clear timeout error instead of looping forever.
